5.2.4 Wang Kin House (Block D)  
The investigation at Wang Kin House (Block D) was firstly conducted by SStnO CHAN Kin-lok on 27.11.2025. During the inspection, the main power switch was firstly found at the “OFF” position and the indicator lamp not illuminated. When the main power switch was turned to the “ON” position by SStnO CHAN, the indicator lamp of the FS pump panel illuminated. The FAS was preliminarily tested by triggering the test switch but failed to work.

5.2.5 Wang Tai House (Block E)  
The investigation at Wang Tai House (Block E) was firstly conducted by SStnO CHAN Kin-lok on 27.11.2025. During the inspection, the main power switch was found at the “OFF” position and the indicator lamp not illuminated. Due to waterlogging in the fire pump room and potential risk of electrical leakage, SStnO CHAN refrained from operating any button or switch in the pump room. Consequently, the FAS could not be tested.
